scope: Main meadow only; reusable textures and separate flat stepping stones

prompts.grass: Seamlessly repeatable painted cel lime and olive meadow grass, broad quiet patches, flat orthographic, no lighting, roads or objects.
prompts.earth: Seamlessly repeatable painted golden beige earth, broad tan sand and soft darker variations, flat, no complete path, grass or objects.
prompts.stones: Six separate flat grey beige irregular stepping slabs in 3 by 2 grid, high view 60 to 65 degrees, transparent gutters, thin olive grey contour, no ground or cast shadow.
